gh-arcade.description: A browser game platform for discovering and instantly playing strategy, action, and casual games.
gh-arcade.detailedDescription: A web game platform featuring Three Kingdoms strategy games, Echo Maze, Slither, and more. Players can search by name and tags, filter by genre, and launch games directly. The platform uses React and TypeScript, with Three.js for 3D games.
gh-arcade.role: Product planning, UI design, game development, and deployment
contributions: Built game search and genre navigation
Developed strategy, action, and casual games

hovie.description: A movie and TV discovery website powered by the TMDB API.
hovie.detailedDescription: Browse movies and TV shows by genre, then explore synopses, cast information, and trailers on detail pages. Responsive layouts support both desktop and mobile browsing.
hovie.role: Planning, UI design, frontend development, and deployment
hovie.challenge: Help users navigate a large catalog and move naturally from discovery to detailed information.
contributions: Designed the TMDB content discovery structure
Implemented genre lists and detail pages
Built responsive layouts and deployed the service
hovie.outcome: Delivered a responsive browsing flow from content discovery to trailer playback.

run-river.description: A running app for planning routes on Kakao Maps and tracking workouts by distance, time, or intervals.
run-river.detailedDescription: Plan running and walking routes with Kakao Maps and OSRM, then record workouts in distance, time, or interval modes. Features include pace-based MET calorie estimates, shareable workout cards, voice guidance, and weekly challenges. PWA support provides an app-like mobile experience.
run-river.role: Product planning, full-stack development, and PWA implementation
run-river.challenge: Connect map-based route planning with workout tracking in a smooth mobile experience.
contributions: Integrated Kakao Maps with OSRM route calculation
Implemented pace and MET-based workout records
Added voice guidance, share cards, and PWA support
run-river.outcome: Combined route planning, workout tracking, and sharing into a mobile-focused running experience.

kimgeonho-dev.description: An interactive developer portfolio inspired by the VS Code interface.
kimgeonho-dev.detailedDescription: A portfolio website inspired by VS Code, featuring a sidebar, terminal, and keyboard shortcuts. It brings together project stories, a technical blog, and GitHub activity, with themes and keyboard navigation.
kimgeonho-dev.role: UX design, frontend development, and content publishing
kimgeonho-dev.challenge: Keep the VS Code concept while helping visitors without a development background find key information.
contributions: Built navigation around tabs and a sidebar
Combined projects and a technical blog
kimgeonho-dev.outcome: Adapted the character of a development tool into a portfolio browsing experience.

meallog.description: A meal tracking web app combining food logging and health management.
meallog.detailedDescription: Offers meal suggestions by time of day, food and calorie tracking, weight monitoring, and nutrition pattern analysis. An 87-item menu database powers suggestions that avoid repetition. Includes a BMI calculator, photo uploads, and a slot-machine animation interface. PWA support enables app-like use, and records are stored locally in the browser.

wedding-plan.description: A web app for organizing wedding preparations.
wedding-plan.detailedDescription: Organize wedding schedules, budgets, and checklists in one place. Firebase provides authentication and real-time data synchronization.

balance-plan.title: Balance Plan
balance-plan.description: A personal finance app for recording income and expenses and reviewing monthly trends.
balance-plan.detailedDescription: Record income and expenses, manage categories, and review monthly spending. The interface helps users understand spending patterns, manage budgets, and improve everyday financial habits.
